title: Separate wire fields from labels and scientific meaning
objective: Add a strict additive variable identity boundary, replayable semantic extraction and explicit unresolved name mappings while preserving frozen contracts and historical proposal replay.
outcome: Variable documentation retains literal wire names, labels, concepts, definitions, types, units, codebooks, provenance and exact release/schema context without publication approval.

commits.subject: Add scoped variable identity semantics
commits.instructions: Define strict v1.2 variable identity fields, context-scoped IDs and catalog delegation without weakening immutable endpoint checks. Complete the existing v1.2.0 variable-identity schema as a private package with a descriptor, README, offline strict Ajv2020 validator and meaningful positive/negative tests. Preserve the schema bytes, frozen v1.0/v1.1 contracts and all-version runner; no route activation, release approval or scientific authority. The root package manifest remains unchanged and package-lock may contain only the v1.2 workspace descriptor and local node_modules link.
commits.verification: Focused identity schema/unit/context tests, frozen machine contract byte check, identity package test and seal validation. Run the v1.2 package test and validate commands, then prove all three machine-toolkit versions execute under contract discovery and that the complete lock object has only the two authorized entries.
